message.content:
Here are some of the major airports in the United States, ranked by passenger traffic and importance:

| Airport | City | State | IATA Code | Notable Features |
|---------|------|-------|-----------|------------------|
| Hartsfield‑Jackson Atlanta International Airport (ATL) | Atlanta | Georgia | ATL | Largest airport in the world by passenger traffic; major hub for Delta Air Lines. |
| Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) | Los Angeles | California | LAX | Major gateway to Asia and the Pacific; hub for American Airlines and Delta. |
| Chicago O’Hare International Airport (ORD) | Chicago | Illinois | ORD | One of the busiest airports in the U.S.; hub for United Airlines and American Airlines. |
| Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport (DFW) | Dallas/Fort Worth | Texas | DFW | Hub for American Airlines; one of the largest airports by land area. |
| Denver International Airport (DEN) | Denver | Colorado | DEN | Largest airport in the U.S. by land area; hub for United Airlines and Southwest. |
| John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK) | New York City | New York | JFK | Major international gateway; hub for Delta Air Lines and American Airlines. |
| San Francisco International Airport (SFO) | San Francisco | California | SFO | Major hub for United Airlines; key gateway to Asia. |
| Seattle–Tacoma International Airport (SEA) | Seattle | Washington | SEA | Hub for Alaska Airlines and Delta Air Lines; growing international traffic. |
| Miami International Airport (MIA) | Miami | Florida | MIA | Major hub for American Airlines; key gateway to Latin America. |
| Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport (PHX) | Phoenix | Arizona | PHX | Hub for American Airlines; high volume of domestic flights. |
| Charlotte Douglas International Airport (CLT) | Charlotte | North Carolina | CLT | Hub for American Airlines; one of the busiest airports in the Southeast. |
| Orlando International Airport (MCO) | Orlando | Florida | MCO | Major hub for Southwest Airlines; high volume of leisure travelers. |
| Newark Liberty International Airport (EWR) | Newark | New Jersey | EWR | Hub for United Airlines; major gateway to Europe. |
| Washington Dulles International Airport (IAD) | Washington, D.C. | Virginia | IAD | Hub for United Airlines; major international gateway. |

These airports are among the busiest in terms of passenger traffic, flight operations, and connectivity, serving as major hubs for both domestic and international travel.
